## Batch 50 complete

Created the frontmatter-only A/B pages, the U(2) N=2* model Postulate, and the conditional one-instanton Example. The Example uses Pestun’s full Lie-algebra normalization and records the ADHM framing-sign convention. The source-reported matrix integral is not presented as a continuum proof. [Pestun](https://arxiv.org/pdf/0712.2824), [Peelaers lecture notes](https://indico.math.cnrs.fr/event/3026/attachments/2163/2457/Peelaers-LectureNotes.pdf)

The Postulate is **Step‑1 ready**. The Example is **escalated**: the current ready Q-exact theorem covers massless N=4 SU(2), while the ADHM theorem’s readiness is escalated and the noncompact pushforward and pole matching remain unresolved. The Example records these limits and keeps the calculation conditional.
